description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的某段历史时期里某个周期内的最大回撤数据。可按基金代码筛选指定时间段里某个周期（月/季度/半年/1年/3年/5年/10年/上市以来）的最大回撤数据，返回各个时间点对应的最大回撤值。当用户想了解某公募基金在不同时间段的抗风险能力、最大回撤幅度时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain historical maximum drawdown data for A-share funds. Filters can be applied by fund code and date range, supporting drawdown time granularities including monthly/quarterly/half-year/1 year/3 years/5 years/10 years/since listing, returning date and maximum drawdown value for each period. Call this interface when users want to understand the risk-resilience capability and maximum drawdown magnitude of a fund across different periods, or assess fund stability.

constraints: 开始和结束的时间间隔不超过10年

params.name: endDate
descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
